meta.name: ansible-automation
meta.description: Infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventory. Use for deploying applications, patching, and managing servers.

copy.tagline: 用 Ansible 自动化管理服务器和部署应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量管理服务器或自动化部署流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate server management and application deployment with Ansible
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage servers in bulk or automate deployment workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能编写 Ansible 剧本（playbooks）来自动化多台服务器的配置、应用部署和系统更新。它生成角色（roles）、清单（inventory）等文件，实现基础设施即代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求自动化服务器配置、部署应用、打补丁或管理基础设施时触发。也适用于多服务器编排、云实例配置、容器管理等场景。

say.text: 帮我写一个Ansible playbook来部署Nginx到所有Web服务器。
为生产环境创建自动化打补丁的Playbook，滚动更新。
say.note: Claude会使用serial:1和健康检查确保零停机。

say.text: 配置Ansible inventory，区分开发、测试、生产环境。
say.note: Claude会生成带变量和组的动态清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Ansible playbooks to automate configuration, application deployment, and system updates across multiple servers. It generates roles, inventory files, and implements infrastructure as code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request server configuration automation, app deployment, patching, or infrastructure management. Also suitable for multi-server orchestration, cloud provisioning, container management, etc.

say_en.text: Write an Ansible playbook to deploy Nginx to all web servers.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full playbook with roles and handlers.

say_en.text: Create a patching playbook for production with rolling updates.
say_en.note: Claude uses serial:1 and health checks for zero downtime.

say_en.text: Set up Ansible inventory separating dev, test, and prod environments.
say_en.note: Claude produces dynamic inventory with variables and groups.
